title: Catholicism among New Orleans musicians
summary: He says his family and most downtown musicians were Catholic.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Mr. Dewey, a while ago, we did not ask you any questions at all about your family background, but would you tell me, were your parents and were all the people in your family Catholic?
Yes, sir. They are really Catholic, everyone in my family.
All right. Now, Mr. Dewey, I'd like for you to tell us, if you will, how big a part Catholic musicians played in this growth of jazz in New Orleans. How many of the fellas down there were Catholics?
Mostly. Mostly, mostly the odd number were Catholics, I think, because I lived downtown and most everybody downtown was Catholic.
